_comment: The texts of each autonomous community as an Unciv nation, in each language: the name of its unique (a bonus on the resource it holds most of, relative to its size), the text Unciv shows when a game starts, and what the page and the README say of it (where it starts, its advantage, its start bias, a city-state's type). Terrain and technology names are Unciv's own in that language (android/assets/jsons/translations). English is the mod's own text (jsons/Nations.json) and Spanish its translation (jsons/translations/Spanish.properties). Filled in by pipeline/play.py from unciv.json's summary.

es.intro: $name: $population habitantes en $municipalities municipios (INE, Padrón $year). $start En este mapa tienes $land_tiles casillas de tierra, y en tu tierra y tu costa hay $resource_tiles de las $resource_map_tiles casillas de $resource_word del mapa: tus ciudades sacan una más de comida, producción y oro de cada una que trabajen.$hidden
es.hidden: Ese recurso no se ve ni da nada hasta que descubres $tech.
es.advantage: $resource: $resource_tiles de las $resource_map_tiles casillas de $resource_word del mapa (+1 comida, producción y oro$hidden_short)
es.fallback: ; si no llega a $unique_min en ninguno, entre todos: $names
es.editorial: ; elegido a mano en $names, lo que se espera de cada una

en.intro: $name: $population people in $municipalities municipalities (INE, Padrón $year). $start On this map you have $land_tiles land tiles, and your land and coast hold $resource_tiles of the map's $resource_map_tiles $resource_word tiles: your cities get one more food, production and gold from each one they work.$hidden
en.hidden: That resource stays hidden, and gives nothing, until you discover $tech.
en.advantage: $resource: $resource_tiles of the map's $resource_map_tiles $resource_word tiles (+1 food, production and gold$hidden_short)
en.fallback: , or among all it holds if none reaches $unique_min: $names
en.editorial: ; picked by hand for $names, what anyone expects of each
